   121	def _ck_vec(value, n, lo, hi):
   122	    if type(value) is not list or len(value) != n:
   123	        raise Invalid("wrong vector shape")
   124	    for item in value:
   125	        if type(item) is not int or item < lo or item > hi:
   126	            raise Invalid("vector element out of range")
   127	    return value

   130	def _ck_mat(value, rows, cols, lo, hi):
   131	    if type(value) is not list or len(value) != rows:
   132	        raise Invalid("wrong matrix shape")
   133	    for row in value:
   134	        if type(row) is not list or len(row) != cols:
   135	            raise Invalid("wrong matrix row shape")
   136	        for item in row:
   137	            if type(item) is not int or item < lo or item > hi:
   138	                raise Invalid("matrix element out of range")
   139	    return value

   142	def _ck_edges(value, lo_len, hi_len, lo, hi):
   143	    if type(value) is not list:
   144	        raise Invalid("edges must be a list")
   145	    if len(value) < lo_len or len(value) > hi_len:
   146	        raise Invalid("wrong number of edges")
   147	    previous = None
   148	    for item in value:
   149	        if type(item) is not int or item < lo or item > hi:
   150	            raise Invalid("edge out of range")
   151	        if previous is not None and item <= previous:
   152	            raise Invalid("edges not strictly increasing")
   153	        previous = item
   154	    if value[0] != 0:
   155	        raise Invalid("edges must start at 0")
   156	    return value

   162	def validate(doc):
   163	    """Validate the document and return the replay parameters."""
   164	    _ck_keys(doc, ROOT_KEYS)
   165	    if type(doc["version"]) is not int or doc["version"] != 1:
   166	        raise Invalid("version must be the integer 1")
   167	
   168	    cfg = doc["config"]
   169	    mdl = doc["model"]
   170	    _ck_keys(cfg, CONFIG_KEYS)
   171	    _ck_keys(mdl, MODEL_KEYS)
   172	
   173	    # ---- model ------------------------------------------------------------
   174	    classes = _ck_int(mdl["classes"], 2, 8)
   175	    emb_dim = _ck_int(mdl["embedding_dim"], 1, 4)
   176	    len_emb = _ck_mat(mdl["length_embedding"], 16, emb_dim, -128, 127)
   177	    gap_emb = _ck_mat(mdl["gap_embedding"], 16, emb_dim, -128, 127)
   178	    kernel = _ck_int(mdl["kernel"], 1, 5)
   179	
   180	    conv_w = mdl["conv_weights"]
   181	    if type(conv_w) is not list:
   182	        raise Invalid("conv_weights must be a list")
   183	    filters = len(conv_w)
   184	    if filters < 1 or filters > 8:
   185	        raise Invalid("filter count out of range")
   186	    for tap in conv_w:
   187	        _ck_mat(tap, kernel, 2 * emb_dim, -128, 127)
   188	    conv_b = _ck_vec(mdl["conv_bias"], filters, I32_MIN, I32_MAX)
   189	    conv_s = _ck_vec(mdl["conv_shift"], filters, 0, 16)
   190	    dense_w = _ck_mat(mdl["dense_weights"], classes, filters, -128, 127)
   191	    dense_b = _ck_vec(mdl["dense_bias"], classes, I32_MIN, I32_MAX)
   192	
   193	    # ---- config ------------------------------------------------------------
   194	    nslots = _ck_int(cfg["slots"], 1, 256)
   195	    window = _ck_int(cfg["window"], 1, 16)
   196	    if kernel > window:
   197	        raise Invalid("kernel larger than window")
   198	    idle_timeout = _ck_int(cfg["idle_timeout"], 1, TIME_MAX)
   199	    len_q = _ck_int(cfg["len_quantum"], 1, 65535)
   200	    gap_q = _ck_int(cfg["gap_quantum"], 1, 65535)
   201	    rate_num = _ck_int(cfg["rate_num"], 1, 10 ** 6)
   202	    rate_den = _ck_int(cfg["rate_den"], 1, 10 ** 6)
   203	    bucket_cap = _ck_int(cfg["bucket_capacity"], 1, 512)
   204	    init_tokens = _ck_int(cfg["initial_tokens"], 0, bucket_cap)
   205	    pending_cap = _ck_int(cfg["pending_capacity"], 1, 512)
   206	    nlanes = _ck_int(cfg["lanes"], 1, 4)
   207	    service = _ck_vec(cfg["service"], classes, 1, 10 ** 6)
   208	    fallback = _ck_int(cfg["fallback"], 0, classes - 1)
   209	    time_edges = _ck_edges(cfg["time_edges"], 1, 16, 0, TIME_MAX)
   210	    count_edges = _ck_edges(cfg["count_edges"], 1, 16, 0, 20000)
   211	
   212	    prob = cfg["probability"]
   213	    if type(prob) is not list or len(prob) != len(time_edges):
   214	        raise Invalid("probability table shape")
   215	    for row in prob:
   216	        _ck_vec(row, len(count_edges), 0, 65536)
   217	
   218	    # ---- connections -------------------------------------------------------
   219	    conns = doc["connections"]
   220	    if type(conns) is not list or len(conns) > 2048:
   221	        raise Invalid("connections must be a list of at most 2048 objects")
   222	    seen = set()
   223	    conn_ids = []
   224	    conn_slots = []
   225	    conn_labels = []
   226	    conn_splits = []
   227	    for conn in conns:
   228	        _ck_keys(conn, CONN_KEYS)
   229	        cid = conn["id"]
   230	        if type(cid) is not str or ID_RE.match(cid) is None:
   231	            raise Invalid("bad connection id")
   232	        if cid in seen:
   233	            raise Invalid("duplicate connection id")
   234	        seen.add(cid)
   235	        conn_ids.append(cid)
   236	        conn_slots.append(_ck_int(conn["slot"], 0, nslots - 1))
   237	        conn_labels.append(_ck_int(conn["label"], 0, classes - 1))
   238	        split = conn["split"]
   239	        if type(split) is not str or (split != "dev" and split != "eval"):
   240	            raise Invalid("bad split")
   241	        conn_splits.append(split)
   242	
   243	    # ---- packets ------------------------------------------------------------
   244	    pkts = doc["packets"]
   245	    if type(pkts) is not list or len(pkts) > 20000:
   246	        raise Invalid("packets must be a list of at most 20000 objects")
   247	    pkt_time = []
   248	    pkt_conn = []
   249	    pkt_len = []
   250	    pkt_draw = []
   251	    previous = None
   252	    for pkt in pkts:
   253	        _ck_keys(pkt, PKT_KEYS)
   254	        when = _ck_int(pkt["time"], 0, TIME_MAX)
   255	        if previous is not None and when < previous:
   256	            raise Invalid("packet times must not decrease")
   257	        previous = when
   258	        who = pkt["connection"]
   259	        if type(who) is not str or who not in seen:
   260	            raise Invalid("unknown connection")
   261	        pkt_time.append(when)
   262	        pkt_conn.append(who)
   263	        pkt_len.append(_ck_int(pkt["length"], 0, 65535))
   264	        pkt_draw.append(_ck_int(pkt["draw"], 0, 65535))
   265	
   266	    return {
   267	        "classes": classes,
   268	        "emb_dim": emb_dim,
   269	        "len_emb": len_emb,
   270	        "gap_emb": gap_emb,
   271	        "kernel": kernel,
   272	        "conv_w": conv_w,
   273	        "conv_b": conv_b,
   274	        "conv_s": conv_s,
   275	        "dense_w": dense_w,
   276	        "dense_b": dense_b,
   277	        "filters": filters,
   278	        "slots": nslots,
   279	        "window": window,
   280	        "idle_timeout": idle_timeout,
   281	        "len_q": len_q,
   282	        "gap_q": gap_q,
   283	        "rate_num": rate_num,
   284	        "rate_den": rate_den,
   285	        "bucket_cap": bucket_cap,
   286	        "init_tokens": init_tokens,
   287	        "pending_cap": pending_cap,
   288	        "lanes": nlanes,
   289	        "service": service,
   290	        "fallback": fallback,
   291	        "time_edges": time_edges,
   292	        "count_edges": count_edges,
   293	        "prob": prob,
   294	        "conn_ids": conn_ids,
   295	        "conn_slots": conn_slots,
   296	        "conn_labels": conn_labels,
   297	        "conn_splits": conn_splits,
   298	        "pkt_time": pkt_time,
   299	        "pkt_conn": pkt_conn,
   300	        "pkt_len": pkt_len,
   301	        "pkt_draw": pkt_draw,
   302	    }
